errors.what: Wheel does not dwell: it keeps rotating while the drive pin is outside the slots (pin at top/left/bottom, driver angle beyond +-45 deg). The slot pattern changes steadily from t=0.67 through t=3.33 (axis-aligned at t=0, 45-degree diagonals at t=2.0, nearly axis-aligned again at t=3.67) instead of staying locked at -45 deg from about t=0.5 to t=3.5. Motion looks continuous (about 90 deg per revolution) rather than intermittent.
